adopt:
# Source (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/occupysaas/salescompel
git clone https://github.com/occupysaas/salescompel
cd salescompel

# It needs PostgreSQL, and NOTHING UPSTREAM CREATES THE LOGINS OR THE GRANTS —
# the role names below are examples you choose, not names the project defines.
# The one rule the program enforces: migrations run as an OPERATOR principal
# and serve runs as a RUNTIME principal that does not own the database
# (serve refuses owner privileges). Grant the runtime logins what the schema
# needs; the repository's docs are the authority on which privileges.
createdb salescompel
psql -d salescompel -c "CREATE ROLE salescompel_op  LOGIN PASSWORD 'change-me';"
psql -d salescompel -c "CREATE ROLE salescompel_app LOGIN PASSWORD 'change-me';"
psql -d salescompel -c "CREATE ROLE salescompel_id  LOGIN PASSWORD 'change-me';"

export MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL='postgres://salescompel_op@127.0.0.1:5432/salescompel?sslmode=disable'
export DATABASE_URL='postgres://salescompel_app@127.0.0.1:5432/salescompel?sslmode=disable'
export AUTH_DATABASE_URL='postgres://salescompel_id@127.0.0.1:5432/salescompel?sslmode=disable'

# Build, migrate, create the first user, then serve.
go build -o salescompel ./cmd/salescompel
./salescompel migrate status    # forward-only migrations; never run at startup
./salescompel migrate up
SALESCOMPEL_TENANT=acme SALESCOMPEL_USERNAME=admin@example.com \
  SALESCOMPEL_PASSWORD='<choose-one>' SALESCOMPEL_ROLE=owner \
  ./salescompel user create     # reads the four env vars above
./salescompel serve -addr 127.0.0.1:8080

# The UI is BUILT assets, not source: -assets defaults to web/dist. Build them
# once with Node 22.12 or newer, or pass -assets "" to serve the API alone.
#   (cd web && npm ci && npm run build)
#
# A non-loopback listener is REFUSED without TLS. That is deliberate:
#   ./salescompel serve -addr 0.0.0.0:8443 -tls-cert cert.pem -tls-key key.pem
description:
Kind: pack

What it does
Run SalesCompel — the Apache-2.0, work-in-progress Salesforce replacement from the OccupySaaS community — from source: a Go/PostgreSQL candidate with a Vue record workflow, OAuth with PKCE, and a compatibility laboratory. This pack records how to build and serve it; it never vendors or hosts it.

Runtime
